messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The reporting service is owned by team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- As of 2025-12-05, the Ember team owns reporting, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: As of 2025-05-13, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call. [decision; valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call for the Atlas team; Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team this cycle as of 2025-04-03. [decision; valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12; Tomasz is off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]

Question: Who is on call for the team that owns reporting?
